title: Zero-step rightward cascade
statement: Let $\ell>0$ and let $z$ be a configuration of $\ell$ zones. If the innermost right zone is nonempty and the innermost left zone has room for one additional cell, then the concatenated left-side contents after the zero-step rightward cascade equal the home cell followed by the original concatenated left-side contents, and the concatenated right-side contents equal the tail of the original concatenated right-side contents.
hypotheses_covered: the innermost right zone is nonempty
the innermost left zone length plus one is at most its capacity
